comment: Real, varied claim sources for the local end-to-end gate. Deliberately mixed: arXiv PDFs with no runnable repository, GitHub repositories that do have one, a pinned revision, and a vendor marketing page. Several of these are expected to end in could_not_verify or inconclusive — that is the honest-failure path, not a bug.

urls.expectation: multimodal PDF parse; no runnable repository is linked, so a non-verified verdict is the correct outcome
BLEU claim extracted from a table; no reproducible repository
repository present; evaluation needs COCO weights and data, so expect the bounded debug loop and an honest failure

urls.shape: GitHub README at a pinned revision
urls.expectation: exercises the revision path of the execution plan
WER claim; large model download will not complete inside the sandbox timeout
a small pure-Python repository whose test suite actually installs and runs in the sandbox
marketing multiplier claim with no repository; must not be reported as verified
benchmark table on a documentation page; no reproducible artifact
